author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
Maps which apps use which devices and in what role, with flowcharts of Rule Machine rules.

Read-only. It never commands a device or changes an app.
View the map in a desktop browser, not a phone.
After install, add the app, select your devices and press Done. The first scan starts on its own and takes about two minutes on a large hub.

1.0.2 - if a second copy of this app is installed on the same hub, it is no longer drawn on the map. No change for a normal single installation.
